aboutGame.title: What is Heart of Artemisa?
paragraphs: Heart of Artemisa is a rhythm action adventure game with dungeon crawler and roguelite elements developed by Camacebra Games. Set in a 2D pixel art dark fantasy world inspired by Greek mythology, players explore cursed subterranean caverns, solve harmonic puzzles, and fight mythical foes at the beat of the music.

Movement and combat are strictly tied to the rhythm of the soundtrack. Striking squarely on the beat multiplies your damage and staggers aggressive monsters, while off-beat swings leave you vulnerable. Master 4 weapon archetypes, conquer 8 unique enemy types, and navigate challenging multi-phase boss encounters.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Heart of Artemisa.

items.question: What is Heart of Artemisa?
items.answer: Heart of Artemisa is a rhythm-based action adventure roguelite developed by Camacebra Games. Players explore mysterious caves and dark dungeons, battling enemies and solving puzzles synchronized to the musical beat in a 16-bit pixel art fantasy world inspired by Greek mythology.

items.question: How does combat work in Heart of Artemisa?
items.answer: In Heart of Artemisa, combat is tied to the soundtrack tempo. Striking precisely on the beat multiplies your damage output by up to 2.0x, triggers stagger effects, and builds rhythm streaks. Swinging off-beat deals reduced damage and leaves you vulnerable.

items.question: Which weapons are available in Heart of Artemisa?
items.answer: The Heart of Artemisa demo features 4 distinct weapon archetypes: the balanced Broadsword, the fast Rapier, the long-range Polearm, and the heavy Hammer, each with unique rhythmic attack cadences and timing windows.

items.question: Is a controller recommended for Heart of Artemisa?
items.answer: Yes, developer Camacebra Games explicitly recommends playing Heart of Artemisa with a gamepad. Modern controllers such as Xbox, DualShock, and DualSense provide tactile feedback that helps internalize the musical pulse.

items.question: Where can I play the Heart of Artemisa demo?
items.answer: You can download and play the official Heart of Artemisa demo on Steam, which includes over 40 minutes of gameplay, 4 weapon archetypes, 8 enemy types, and a multi-phase boss encounter.
